Gwalior Road Subsidence Near Dholibua Bridge Repaired

In Gwalior, a road near the Dholibua bridge subsided, causing cracks in more than seven houses. The damaged road and houses have since been repaired. Additionally, the retaining wall of the Swarn Rekha river was also improved.
